name: healdesk-aya-ad
description: The AYA motion-design ad (SCRIPT.md), built in Remotion.

scripts.soundtrack: node scripts/soundtrack.mjs public/soundtrack.raw.wav && ffmpeg -v error -y -i public/soundtrack.raw.wav -af loudnorm=I=-14:TP=-1:LRA=20 -ar 44100 public/soundtrack.wav && rm public/soundtrack.raw.wav
scripts.render: npm run soundtrack && npm run render:hero && npm run render:feed && npm run render:wide
scripts.render:hero: remotion render src/index.ts AyaHero out/aya-hero-9x16.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:feed: remotion render src/index.ts AyaFeed out/aya-feed-4x5.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
scripts.render:wide: remotion render src/index.ts AyaWide out/aya-wide-16x9.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 18
